Sam (PM): Quick sync: locking GA acceptance criteria for the roadmap slice. Need final call on SLA tiers, fallback policy, and billing backstop before I update the public roadmap.
Ivy (Eng): From perf runs: hosted p95 ~190ms on 4k median; dedicated pools consistently ~100ms p95.
Rafael - Support: Enterprise pilot wants 110ms p95. If we promise that, support needs a clear oncall escalation and a customer-facing incident SLA doc.
Nora (Fin): Pricing note: Dedicated SLO at ~1.9x unit cost looks defensible; need explicit uplift number for the contract template.
Sam (PM): Proposal: public hosted SLA = 200ms p95; Dedicated SLO = 110ms p95 as a paid tier with contract uplift. Add fallback: auto-route to higher-precision variant if fallback_rate > threshold.
Ivy (Eng): Runtime work: tag requests with "slo_tier" and "model_variant"; emit fallback events. Also add an eval gate: quantized variants must pass critical prompt set within 2% quality delta.
Rafael - Support: Paging thresholds: page if regional impact >=3% of requests for >3 minutes OR error-rate >0.5%. I'll draft the runbook and the customer one-pager.
Nora (Fin): Billing backstop: prefer notify+opt-out by default; credit formula to be in contract if misses persist >2 hours in billing month. Legal to sign off.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release/inference-ga -> 10 hosts :rocket:
Sam (PM): Owners: Ivy->runtime tags & eval gates; Rafael->support runbook + one-pager; Nora->pricing uplift wording & contract clause; I'll update acceptance matrix and file PR tomorrow AM.
Ivy (Eng): Opening infra tickets for telemetry retention and per-route histograms.
Rafael - Support:+1
Nora (Fin):+1
Sam (PM): Great, locking these decisions unless objections by EOD.
